example.title: King Street Houses in Charleston, SC (building 2 of the row)

brief: A harbour-town commercial building: King Street Houses in Charleston, SC (building 2 of the row); see the photo for its storefronts, awnings and signs. One photo; year estimated. Older than 1970: the Charleston / Nantucket / Cape Cod main-street blocks (the town's model) are 18th-19th-century. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
